name: Himari Sanada
source:
Himari is a gentle girl who works in her family's cafe, she's very dedicated to her job but is otherwise unremarkable. She has decent grades despite often forgetting to study, and enjoys playing video games in her little spare time. As a child, her photo was chosen by Asakura Coffee for use as their logo, but she's rarely ever been recognised from it. On one occasion she was distracted, causing her to mishear a customer's order; in retaliation, he threw the hot drink at Himari's back.

[From [url=https://www.mangofactory.win/kumitantei/characters]official site[/url]]
